Message -> traveler state (+ profile, location, live weather) -> ranked, feasible plan.
Signed in: the profile and learned context shape the starting state, and each message
nudges that context. Everything assumed is listed in `context.assumptions`.

Accept / reject (with reason) / skip / rating. Returns the updated state and fresh
recommendations; the provider only ever sees aggregates (kind + reason, star ratings).
Signed in: what it taught about their taste is also saved to their profile context.

Hold spots for a planned stop. No payment: a stub that respects capacity per start time.

ponytail: discovery still checks capacity per booking, not spots left per slot; a full slot
is refused here with a clear reason. Move the per-slot count into feasibility if it matters.

AdminUserRow.title: AdminUserRow
AdminUserRow.description: What an admin may see about a user: account facts only, never profile data.

AvailabilityWindow.title: AvailabilityWindow
AvailabilityWindow.description:
The experience must start and finish within [start, end].

`slots` set → fixed start times only. `on_date` set → one-off event (festival, show).

ClosedNow.title: ClosedNow
ClosedNow.description: A good match that can't happen in this window, and when it next can.

Companion.title: Companion
Companion.description: A person the user often travels with; reused when planning trips (P3).

ContextImport.title: ContextImport
ContextImport.description: A past itinerary or trip notes, in the traveler's words.

Evidence.title: Evidence
Evidence.description:
Where one attribute's value came from and when it was last confirmed.

`estimate`: nobody confirmed it; it's the typical value for this kind of place (open data
without hours/prices). Always flagged low confidence, never presented as fact.

ParsedRequest.title: ParsedRequest
ParsedRequest.description: Only what the traveler said. None = not mentioned (keep previous value).

Profile.title: Profile
Profile.description:
Everything used to personalise recommendations. All optional except the name.
Sensitive fields (age, accessibility, diet) are owner-only: never shown to admins/providers.

ProfileContext.title: ProfileContext
ProfileContext.description: What the planner has learned about the traveler, visible and correctable (doc §12.2).

Question.title: Question
Question.description: One onboarding question. `id` is the Profile field the answer is saved to.

Stop.title: Stop
Stop.description: One itinerary entry. experience_id=None for the traveler's own commitments (train, hotel).

Traveler.title: Traveler
Traveler.description: Stable-ish profile of one person in the group.

TripDraft.title: TripDraft
TripDraft.description:
What the "Plan a trip" wizard collects. Shortlist, stay pick, itinerary, splits and
feedback are added as optional fields in P4-P6, so drafts saved now stay valid.

TripTraveler.title: TripTraveler
TripTraveler.description: One person on a trip. `is_me` marks the account owner (their profile can fill it in).
